description: A clock that can drop or displace beats at random, driving an ADSR envelope which in turn drives a VCA.

params.text: How long the envelope's gate stays high, as a share of the clock interval.
How often a beat is displaced off the grid.
How much the MOD jack moves whichever the switch has selected.
Chooses what the MOD jack and knob act on: up they move the clock rate, middle they move how often beats are displaced, down the jack is taken as an external clock instead.

inputs.text: Moves the clock rate or the displacement amount, by as much as the MOD knob allows, or takes over as the clock when the switch is down.
Audio for the VCA. Patch something here and OUT 2 carries that audio shaped by the envelope rather than the envelope voltage.

outputs.text: The envelope as a voltage, or the audio at IN 2 with that envelope applied when IN 2 is patched.
A gate on every beat the clock produces.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.
